# BuildFlow Governed Agent Action Layer

Evercraft public capability ID: buildflow-bounded-agent-action-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public handoff: https://base44.app/api/apps/6ab26dc00debf9a25bca5f3e/functions/enterpriseOpsAgentRoute

## Use this when

- let an AI act on business systems safely
- AI agent needs approval before it changes ERP data
- prevent stale approvals in agent workflows
- add idempotency and receipts to AI business actions
- give an LLM bounded enterprise permissions
- AI should prepare actions but not become the authority

## Problem

An AI/agent needs to prepare or route enterprise actions while policy, tenant, version, approval, value and idempotency constraints remain authoritative outside the model.

## Inputs

Authenticated ProposedAction, exact subject version, AuthorizationGrant and required approvals.

## Outputs

Policy disposition, internal ApprovalRequest where allowed and ActionExecutionReceipt for bounded internal actions.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
- Human UI required: yes
- Confirmation: The model is never authority. Material actions require configured grants and human confirmation. External purchasing/payment/accounting writes are currently disabled.
- Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
